purpose: Test whether coherent, source-faithful Interslavic choices create positive marginal comprehension relative to an explicitly East-dominant baseline across separately reported Slavic cohorts, without converting evidence counts, official votes, population, model preference, or internal QA into human intelligibility or canonical authority.

current_work_state.reader_status: complete internally validated historical checkpoint; model-authored and not native/community certified

authority_pins.status: primary page inspected; exact local byte snapshot required before item recruitment
interface inspected; it contains no participant outcome corpus

typed_evidence_dag.role: provenance and separate support, candidate, competitor, adverse, absence, and veto channels

declared_family_cohort_tree.role: dependence, sampling coverage, and missing-branch visibility

governance_comparators.role: show how official votes, branch equality, and population sensitivity differ

empirical_comprehension_outcomes.role: only permitted basis for a marginal human-intelligibility index within sampled scope

editorial_decision_ledger.role: constrained choice record after evidence and review gates

cohort_tree.missing_leaf_rule: not_recruited_or_not_estimable; never impute from relatives and never serialize as zero effect

governance_comparators.tie_rule: population according to the official design-criteria page
governance_comparators.small_language_rule: sub-million languages do not formally vote but must still be considered
governance_comparators.montenegrin_rule: record participant outcomes separately; do not rewrite the historical official group or infer an extra vote
governance_comparators.decision_role: comparison and community-process question only; no automatic promotion and no empirical outcome weighting

governance_comparators.within_branch_rule: report every sampled leaf first; any aggregate uses a frozen leaf standardization rule and within-language source saturation
governance_comparators.decision_role: primary fairness comparator for sampled-scope reporting; still not an auto-decision
never primary; never substitutes for missing leaves
surface the worst sampled cohort and all unknown cohorts; a grand mean cannot erase harm

decision_family_plan.status: twelve_family_frame_defined; exact structural units, inflections, evidence edges, and all arm bytes not yet frozen
per_family_requirements: one exact controlled concept and sense
at least one formula or definition context and one running-prose context
every required inflected form, not an isolated lemma pasted into prose
exact German structural and source locators
typed support, competitor, adverse, absence, and veto edge IDs
an explicit absent reason for any arm that cannot be honestly constructed

arms.state: exists; exact per-item bytes must be pinned
arms.may_duplicate_role: dominant_east_baseline when byte-identical; do not double-count

arms.role: current official dictionary, grammar, voting, and orthography-supported baseline
arms.state: construct only where exact versioned authority exists; otherwise arm_absent_reason required
must be defined and hash-pinned before randomization; never choose it retrospectively as the worst arm

arms.role: row-verified candidate, coherent doublet, or first-use gloss policy
arms.state: proposal only until exact evidence, grammar, source, and review gates pass
not a bridge candidate and requires a qualified native source/reviewer

task_levels.minimum_per_family: two observations: formula/definition and running prose
task_levels.constraint: Each participant sees one arm per decision family; no repeated-arm learning of the same concept.
Arms must be information-matched, grammatical, typographically equivalent, and source-faithful.

task_levels.target_length: approximately 180-300 words per coherent arm version
task_levels.constraint: No tokenwise best-word mosaic is an admissible participant arm. Morphology, connectives, compounds, coreference, and terminology must form a coherent passage.

sampling_plan.ethics_and_privacy_state: not_started; no recruitment or personal data collection before consent, privacy, storage, withdrawal, and applicable ethics review are documented

stage_0_instrument_feasibility.provisional_target: at least 12 analyzable participants per available core leaf
stage_0_instrument_feasibility.claim_limit: defect detection and rough hierarchical estimates only; not decision-grade canonicalization

stage_1_decision_grade_extension.sample_size_rule: freeze by preregistered simulation using pilot participant/item variance and a human-ratified no-harm margin

sampling_plan.macrobranch_launch_floor: at least two independently sampled leaf standards in each macrobranch before branch comparisons
sampling_plan.small_cohort_rule: retain target_n, recruited_n, analyzable_n, route/window, shortfall reason, not_estimable status, and claim consequence; never impute from a relative
sampling_plan.missing_leaf_claim_consequence: prohibit all-Slavic, pan-Slavic, maximum-intelligibility, and equivalent claims; report sampled-language scope only
sampling_plan.optional_stopping: prohibited; recruitment window, n_min, n_max, exclusions, and analysis freeze before unblinding

randomization_and_masking.lexeme_and_sentence_design: balanced incomplete Latin-square by participant, family, arm, branch, and script
randomization_and_masking.passage_design: balanced incomplete block; each source passage seen once per participant under one coherent arm
randomization_and_masking.seed_state: must be hash-committed before arm labels are unblinded
randomization_and_masking.free_response_review: at least two qualified reviewers blinded to arm; AI may assist error mining but cannot be sole gold-standard scorer
randomization_and_masking.script_policy: primary presentation in a competent preferred script; separately randomized dual-script subset may estimate script effects; derived Cyrillic is never a language vote

analysis_plan.primary_contrast: For leaf or declared macrobranch g and task level k, arm-minus-dominant-baseline effect Delta[g,k,a] = E[Y_k | a,g] - E[Y_k | dominant_east_baseline,g].
models: passage score: binomial or beta-binomial mixed model
correct-trial response time: lognormal mixed model
false-friend outcome: multinomial or prespecified binary error model
analysis_plan.partial_pooling_limit: May stabilize estimates but may not turn an unsampled leaf into observed evidence or conceal a negative small-leaf estimate.
analysis_plan.margin_state: derive from calibration/test-retest evidence or human ratification and freeze before unblinding; never select after outcomes

hard_gates.criterion: exact German authority and structural source locators pinned
official design-criteria, grammar, dictionary, orthography, and transliterator versions saved and hashed
all 12 decision families and every inflected arm byte frozen before outcome inspection
source meaning, mathematics, information content, grammar, typography, formula boundaries, and passage coherence matched across arms
support, competitor, adverse, absence, and veto evidence linked by exact IDs
ethics, consent, privacy, retention, withdrawal, and pseudonymization review documented
recruitment targets, windows, exclusions, random seed, instruments, answer keys, and analysis plan hash-frozen before unblinding
at least two independently sampled leaves per macrobranch for any macrobranch claim
no adequately sampled macrobranch or leaf crosses the preregistered harm or false-friend margin
passage-level branch-equal marginal gain interval above zero and no sentence/passage contradiction to lexical gain
all missing or underpowered leaves reported as unknown or not_estimable
qualified blinded review completed; model scoring not sole authority
external/community review received for any community-legitimacy or canonical claim
no scalar, official vote, D1, KL, source count, or grand mean auto-promotes a form

restart_conditions: wrong German source or structural alignment
grammar or typography defect affecting only one arm
leaked answer key or repeated passage
participant exclusion or stopping rule changed after effect viewing
adversarial_checks: Repeated Russian or Ukrainian sources are counted as independent breadth.
Belarusian is represented only through Russian or Ukrainian.
Rusyn, Sorbian, or Kashubian disappears because recruitment is difficult.
Montenegrin is silently folded into Serbian participant outcomes or inserted as an extra official vote.
A missing leaf is imputed from relatives or treated as zero harm.
The final claim says all Slavs when any declared leaf is unestimated.
A macrobranch result rests on only one leaf standard.
Hierarchical shrinkage conceals a negative small-leaf estimate.
Russian exposure is omitted or measured too coarsely.
Internationalisms win because recruitment overrepresents English or German educated mathematicians.
Population weighting becomes the primary result.
The asymmetric historical dependence_pd tree is confused with the official six-vote comparator.
Dictionary presence, D1, KL, official votes, or source counts are called intelligibility.
current_v018 and dominant_east_baseline are byte-identical but counted as independent arms.
One candidate arm is less grammatical, longer, shorter, or typographically worse.
One arm gets a doublet, definition, or gloss unavailable to matched arms without explicit policy.
Response options are pivot-translated through English or Russian rather than independently qualified.
Free responses are scored only by AI or by reviewers who know the arm.
A participant sees the same decision family under multiple arms and learns the answer.
A passage arm is assembled by token substitution without repairing morphology, connectives, compounds, reference, and terminology coherence.
A locally recognizable lexeme is inserted into a globally incoherent register.
Passage questions are answerable through keyword spotting alone.
Only terminology-heavy passages are tested and proof-connective prose is absent.
One script is treated as inherently superior or Cyrillic Interslavic is counted as a language witness.
Script proficiency and preferred script are confounded with native branch.
Recruitment stopping or exclusions change after arm effects are viewed.
A source or translation defect is misdiagnosed as a comprehension effect.
Only easy pan-root concepts are selected while held terms, connectives, and false friends are avoided.
A negative cohort result is averaged away by a positive Russian result.
Unknown is serialized or narrated as pass.
